title: Partial-fraction decomposition conjecture for flat-space wavefunctions
statement:
Let $G=(V,E)$ be a Feynman graph with $n$ vertices. Let $\mathcal{F}=\{H_1,H_2,\dots,H_r\}$ be the set of spanning subgraphs of $G$, including their orientations, and write $H_i^1,\ldots,H_i^{s_i}$ for the connected components of $H_i$. For a connected oriented subgraph $H$, let $R_H(X,Y)$ be the rational function defined from the linear forms $\ell(H)$ and the admissible positive-degree connected subgraphs, with $R_H(X,Y)=0$ when $H$ contains a directed cycle.

**Flat-space partial-fraction decomposition conjecture.** The flat-space wavefunction can be decomposed into partial fractions as

$$
\psi_{\text{flat}}=\sum_{H_i\in\mathcal{F}}(-1)^{n-1-|E(H_i)|}\prod_{j=1}^{s_i}R_{H_i^j}(X,Y).
$$

This claim gives a graph-theoretic partial-fraction formula for the flat-space wavefunction. The source presents it as a conjecture but supplies no evidence of resolution in the provided text, so it remains open.
source_name: Claudia Fevola, Guilherme L. Pimentel, Anna-Laura Sattelberger and Tom Westerdijk, “Algebraic Approaches to Cosmological Integrals”, arXiv:2410.14757 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.14757

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
